definitions.gloss: rejuvenation; looking or feeling younger; renewal
definitions.explanation: The process of becoming or looking younger, or of being refreshed and renewed. Used for both physical appearance and for organizations or systems being revitalized.

examples.japanese: {若返|わかがえ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘訣|ひけつ}→秘訣：13750_hiketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the secret to rejuvenation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{若返|わかがえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This cosmetic product is effective for skin rejuvenation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{加|くわ}わり→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{若返|わかがえ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: With the addition of new members, the team is undergoing rejuvenation.

notes: Derived from the verb ⟦{若返|わかがえ}る→若返る：14003_wakagaeru⟧ (to become younger, to be rejuvenated). Used in beauty and health contexts: {若返|わかがえ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (rejuvenating effect), ⟦アンチ→アンチ：06473_anchi⟧エイジング / {若返|わかがえ}り⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (anti-aging treatment). Also used metaphorically for organizations: ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{若返|わかがえ}り (organizational rejuvenation, bringing in younger members), ⟦{世代交代|せだいこうたい}→世代交代：20569_sedaikoutai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{若返|わかがえ}り (generational change and renewal).
